svg.title: Simplified mission state machine, corrected
svg.desc: Preflight, takeoff, transit, grid sweep, center on die, RTL, done. Takeoff requires healthy estimator, armed and offboard on. Target lost during centering resumes the sweep. Sweep done with no target goes to RTL. Any airborne state goes to failsafe on VIO or link loss, and to RTL on low battery or time limit.
svg.text: Any airborne state: VIO lost or link lost goes to failsafe
Any airborne state: low battery or time limit goes to RTL
Target lost 2 s: resume sweep where it left off
